category_override: disputed or partial; not a resolution
notes: l = 3 holds for abelian groups (Luczak and Schoen, Colloq. Math. 71 (1996) 149-151); open for non-abelian groups and for l >= 4. Guy's third edition cites the paper in C14 but still says l = 3 is unproved, so the open part is the non-abelian case. Outside Lean: the Luczak-Schoen theorem (abstract read, proof not checked).

sources.cite: T. Luczak, T. Schoen, On strongly sum-free subsets of abelian groups, Colloq. Math. 71 (1996) 149-151
